name: Nauru
description: Nauru, the world's smallest island republic, from its twelve clans to German rule, phosphate, Japanese occupation, independence in 1968 and its rise and fall.

checkpoints.name: The clans
checkpoints.note: Micronesians and Polynesians settled the island. Guns brought a ten-year war from 1878.

checkpoints.name: Phosphate
checkpoints.note: Germany took the island in 1888, and phosphate mining began in 1906. Australia ran it after the war.

checkpoints.name: Independent Nauru
checkpoints.note: Nauru became independent in 1968, grew rich on phosphate and then lost its wealth when the rock ran out.
